# AB_C_combined — A (T(N) ladder) + B (51200 failure) + C (fractional regime) in one queue.
# Generated by concatenating ladder_T_N.txt, fix_51200.txt, fractional_regime.txt. Do not edit by hand.

# A — T(N) exponent ladder. The decisive test: does the iteration count grow with N?
#
# QUESTION: |F|/N = O(1) or Theta(N^c)? |F| = |B| + sum_t intake_t with intake_t <= 2*gamma*(m+n), so
#   Theta(N^c) requires the ITERATION COUNT T to grow with N. Read T(N) and fit log(|F|/N) vs log(N).
#
# GENERATORS (3 axes, all quadratic, d from the generator):
#   planted (Monge)  : clean, |S| = n            [planting_sweep]
#   fractional       : |S| in [n, 2n]            [fractional_sweep]   <- the regime we just unlocked
#   duplicate (d=1)  : natural ties              [degenerate_natural]
#
# SIZES: 3200 6400 12800 25600 51200 (full 5-point ladder; ~24h budget approved).
# MAX-ITERATIONS 200 so nothing caps spuriously. --scan hello --solver cupdlpx (the target path).

# --- A1-A5: planted Monge, prune=none (baseline) ---
python -m iot_experiments.core.planting_sweep --families quadratic --dims 8 --sizes 3200 6400 12800 25600 51200 --seeds 0 --g-profiles zero --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/planting/A1_monge_noprune
# --- A6-A10: planted Monge, hyst+reg (the winner; eps=1e-4 tau=1e-1) ---
python -m iot_experiments.core.planting_sweep --families quadratic --dims 8 --sizes 3200 6400 12800 25600 51200 --seeds 0 --g-profiles zero --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy hysteresis --tau-prune 1e-1 --tie-break regularized --epsilon 1e-4 --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/planting/A2_monge_hystreg
# --- A11-A15: fractional sf=1.0, prune=none ---
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 3200 6400 12800 25600 51200 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/A3_frac_noprune
# --- A16-A20: fractional sf=1.0, hyst+reg ---
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 3200 6400 12800 25600 51200 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy hysteresis --tau-prune 1e-1 --tie-break regularized --epsilon 1e-4 --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/A4_frac_hystreg
# --- A21-A25: duplicate d=1, prune=none (natural degeneracy alarm) ---
python -m iot_experiments.core.degenerate_natural --kinds duplicate --family quadratic --dims 1 --n 3200 6400 12800 25600 51200 --seeds 0 --scan hello --prune-strategy none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/degenerate/A5_dup1_noprune

# B — why did hysteresis+regularized FAIL at n=51200? (F2 capped at 60 it / 3905 s while A3 at 12800 converged)
#
# QUESTION: is it SIZE, tau, or epsilon? Three arms at 51200 plus one midpoint at 25600.
# All planted Monge, quadratic, d=8, seed 0, g=0, --scan hello --solver cupdlpx.

# B1: midpoint 25600 with the standard winner -> locate the size where it breaks
python -m iot_experiments.core.planting_sweep --families quadratic --dims 8 --sizes 25600 --seeds 0 --g-profiles zero --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy hysteresis --tau-prune 1e-3 --tie-break regularized --epsilon 1e-4 --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/planting/B1_mid25600
# B2: 51200, tau=1e-1 (the C2 winner tau) -> is tau the problem at scale?
python -m iot_experiments.core.planting_sweep --families quadratic --dims 8 --sizes 51200 --seeds 0 --g-profiles zero --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy hysteresis --tau-prune 1e-1 --tie-break regularized --epsilon 1e-4 --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/planting/B2_51200_tau1e1
# B3: 51200, eps=3e-5 -> is epsilon the problem at scale?
python -m iot_experiments.core.planting_sweep --families quadratic --dims 8 --sizes 51200 --seeds 0 --g-profiles zero --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy hysteresis --tau-prune 1e-3 --tie-break regularized --epsilon 3e-5 --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/planting/B3_51200_eps3e5
# B4: 51200, winner settings, cap 200 -> "needs more rounds" vs "genuinely cycles"
python -m iot_experiments.core.planting_sweep --families quadratic --dims 8 --sizes 51200 --seeds 0 --g-profiles zero --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy hysteresis --tau-prune 1e-3 --tie-break regularized --epsilon 1e-4 --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/planting/B4_51200_cap200

# C — the fractional regime (|S| in [n, 2n], p=1): the regime the loop was DESIGNED for, first GPU run.
#
# QUESTION: does the loop solve genuine fractional instances, and is is_optimal True? (A local check at
#   n=300-400 gave is_optimal=False on some fractional instances with delta=0: the returned theta was
#   optimal only to ~1e-5. This batch says whether that is systematic for fractional or a small-n quirk.)
# Read |S|/n, n_split, n_skipped, T, |F|/(m+n), is_optimal, relative_gap.

# C1: 3200, sf=1.0, sf-ratio 0.5, cap 4.0, prune=none
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 3200 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/C1_n3200_sf1
# C2: 12800, sf=1.0
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 12800 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/C2_n12800_sf1
# C3: 12800, sf=0.5 (half the sources split -> |S| in between)
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 12800 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 0.5 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/C3_n12800_sf05
# C4: 12800, tight slide cap 0.5 (fewer splits, more skipped)
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 12800 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 0.5 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/C4_n12800_cap05
# C5: 12800, lopsided split ratio 0.9 (mass mostly on the second target)
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 12800 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.9 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/C5_n12800_sr09
# C6: 12800, sf=1.0 with hyst+reg (does the winning pruning help on fractional too?)
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family quadratic --point-dimension 8 --sizes 12800 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy hysteresis --tau-prune 1e-1 --tie-break regularized --epsilon 1e-4 --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/C6_n12800_hystreg
# C7: diagonal family, sf=1.0 (the other supported family), 12800
python -m iot_experiments.core.fractional_sweep --family diagonal --point-dimension 8 --sizes 12800 --seeds 0 --split-fractions 1.0 --split-ratios 0.5 --slide-caps 4.0 --scan hello --solver cupdlpx --prune-strategy none --tie-break none --max-iterations 200 --out iot_experiments/core/out/fractional/C7_diag_n12800
